messages:
tyler: PR ready: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/77654 - change to fallback routing TTL + auth header ordering. Small code + config tweak. Need runtime + infra + security eyes before we merge. Target merge Thu 10:30am PT canary. Can anyone take this today? cc @kevin-runtime @maria-platform @sarah-sec
kevin (runtime): looking now. quick q — fallback TTL default goes from 5s -> 1s, right? want to confirm we don't increase cache churn for short seq workloads. also: what happens if model-variant fallback triggers mid-stream?
tyler: yes TTL 5s -> 1s. aim is to reduce latency for cold prefixes. mid-stream fallback should keep KV cache intact because we only route new requests, not switch kernels mid-call. added a comment in the code: `// preserve kv cache on route fallback`
maria (platform): I'll take runtime routing + canary perf. can you paste the perf numbers from the smoke run? prefer a 1h bake after canary. also please add a config flag to gate this so we can toggle quickly if needed.
tyler: pushed a small follow-up commit with `enable_short_ttl=true` flag and a smoke-run log snippet in the PR description. smoke: p50 latency down ~10% on prefix-heavy traces, p95 unchanged.
sarah (security): 👀 on auth header ordering change. Is this purely header re-ordering or does it touch signing/KMS calls? need quick threat note and a test that shows headers preserved for signed requests.
thmas (tyler): (edited) it only reorders headers before proxying to downstream model hosts, no signing changes. added a short threat note in the PR and a unit test asserting header sequence preserved for the proxy path.
chloe (infra): quick infra ask — does the change require a rollout of the routing table or any DB migration? if yes we need a pre-merge migration window.
tyler: no DB migration. routing table change is just config reload. documented rollout steps in the runbook section of the PR.
maria (platform): I can approve runtime/platform once kevin gives runtime sign-off and after I run the canary perf test. timeline: I'll run canary Thu 10:30am PT (as planned) if we get owner LGTM by 9:30am PT.
kevin (runtime): reviewed code, asked for 2 tiny nit fixes on comments and one added unit test — pushed suggestions. behavior looks safe for LRU/KV. I can +1 runtime once those are addressed.
tyler: fixed nits and test, pushed. thanks.
sarah (security): quick thumbs — the threat note looks fine for now, added one comment about logging sensitive headers (masking). otherwise ok to +1 after test CI passes. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: Canary window available Thu 10:30am-11:30am PT. Please add `canary:77654` to the PR description before merging.
tyler: added `canary:77654` and the runbook link. asking for final +1s.
maria (platform): taking canary perf at 10:30am. i'll post results in this thread. if p95 regresses >5% i'll rollback. :ok_hand:
kevin (runtime): +1 runtime, resolving my review.
sarah (security): +1 security (CI green required).
chloe (infra): quick ack from infra. no infra changes needed.
tyler: great — thank you all. will merge after CI and maria's canary run.
